skill.name: seo-fundamentals
skill.description: Learn sustainable SEO principles and inspect public page files for common metadata, heading, and image accessibility issues.
skill.summary: Apply SEO fundamentals and run focused checks on HTML, JSX, and TSX pages.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no findings requiring adjudication. Manual review found no prompt injection, malicious intent, credential access, external commands, or network activity.

content.value_statement: SEO reviews can miss content quality, technical access, and page experience fundamentals. This skill provides practical guidance and a focused local page checker.
actual_capabilities: Explains E-E-A-T, content quality, technical SEO, structured data, and measurement principles.
Provides target values and context for LCP, INP, and CLS.
Finds likely public pages in HTML, HTM, JSX, and TSX files.
Checks titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags, multiple H1 tags, and image alt attributes.
Limits local analysis to 50 page files and summarizes issue counts.
Returns a pass or fail status suitable for local review workflows.
limitations: The checker uses text patterns and does not render pages or execute client-side code.
It does not crawl websites, access analytics, query search engines, or measure live Core Web Vitals.
Page detection uses filename and directory heuristics, so some pages may be skipped.
The guidance cannot guarantee rankings and requires human validation for accuracy and business context.

use_cases.title: Review a Small Website
use_cases.description: Identify common metadata, heading, and image accessibility gaps before publishing public pages.

use_cases.title: Check React Page Components
use_cases.description: Scan likely JSX and TSX pages for basic on-page SEO omissions during development.

use_cases.title: Plan a Sustainable SEO Audit
use_cases.description: Organize reviews around content quality, technical access, page experience, structured data, and measurement.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Fundamentals
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the most important SEO fundamentals for [website type] in a short prioritized checklist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Learn the core concepts before reviewing a site.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page content for title, description, headings, image alt text, intent, clarity, and trust signals: [content].
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate one public page with supplied content.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret Checker Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Prioritize these SEO checker findings by user impact and explain specific corrections: [findings].
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn local checker findings into an editing plan.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO audit plan for [site], covering E-E-A-T, technical access, content quality, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and measurement.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate a comprehensive review across multiple SEO areas.

output_examples.input: Review a product page missing a meta description and image alt text.
output: High priority: Add accurate alt text to informative product images.
Medium priority: Write a concise meta description matching purchase intent.
Verify the title, H1, canonical URL, and product details before publishing.

output_examples.input: Explain whether good Core Web Vitals guarantee strong rankings.
output_examples.output: Core Web Vitals support page experience but do not guarantee rankings. Relevant, useful, trustworthy content remains essential.

output_examples.input: Summarize a scan with three missing descriptions and one duplicate H1.
output_examples.output: Correct the duplicate H1 first, then write distinct descriptions for each affected page. Recheck templates to prevent repeated omissions.

best_practices: Combine checker results with rendered-page inspection, analytics, and search performance data.
Prioritize useful, accurate content and clear user intent before minor metadata refinements.
Review AI-assisted recommendations with subject experts, especially for sensitive or high-impact topics.
anti_patterns: Do not treat keyword repetition as a substitute for useful content.
Do not assume structured data or passing Core Web Vitals guarantees rich results or rankings.
Do not publish unverified AI output or apply automated changes without reviewing page context.

faq.question: Which files can the checker inspect?
faq.answer: It searches for likely public pages in HTML, HTM, JSX, and TSX files.

faq.question: Does it crawl a live website?
faq.answer: No. It reads local project files and makes no network requests.

faq.question: Does it measure Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: No. It explains target values, but live performance measurement requires appropriate field or laboratory tools.

faq.question: How many files does it inspect?
faq.answer: The included checker analyzes at most 50 files identified as likely public pages.

faq.question: Can it guarantee higher search rankings?
faq.answer: No. Rankings depend on relevance, quality, competition, authority, technical access, and other changing signals.

faq.question: Should I publish AI-generated SEO content directly?
faq.answer: No. Review accuracy, originality, clarity, usefulness, and accountability before publishing.
